model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: toyota.com '2027 Toyota C-HR Specifications', 'Overall length: 177.9', both grades in the page's embedded spec data. This is the battery-electric C-HR (Toyota's US C-HR is EV-only for 2026-27).

width_in.note: 'Overall width: 73.6'; mirrors not stated. C/D lists the same figure as width without mirrors.

awd.note: 'DRIVETRAIN: Standard All-Wheel Drive (AWD)'. C/D 2026 trims: SE AWD, XSE AWD.

charge_port.note: 'C-HR's North American Charging Standard (NACS) port gives you access to ... the Tesla Supercharger Network'; 'separate adapters for CCS and J1772 chargers'.

us_status.note: toyota.com '2027 Toyota C-HR' with starting MSRP; the page also links the 2026 C-HR.

entries.note: 'an EPA-estimated 273-mile range rating for XSE'; XSE has 20-in. wheels

epa_range.note: EPA has no 2027 C-HR yet (2027 Toyota model menu checked 2026-09-19, sources/fe-menu-model-2027-toyota.xml). Toyota's stated 2027 figures match EPA's 2026 C-HR AWD 18inch and 20inch listings.

trims.note: toyota.com 2027 C-HR spec table grades 'SE' and 'XSE'; 'Standard All-Wheel Drive (AWD)'. SE has 18-in. wheels, XSE 20-in.

entries.note: Toyota's label is 'Total battery capacity (kWh)', read as gross. C/D's test sheet lists 67 kWh as its own estimate; not used.
C/D test sheet 'Peak Charge Rate, AC/DC: 11.0/150 kW'. No Toyota peak figure on the saved toyota.com pages; pressroom.toyota.com is blocked (Cloudflare).
'DC Fast Charging time (from 10% to 80%, in ideal conditions): ~30 MIN (WITH 150 KW OR ABOVE DCFC)'.
Not listed in toyota.com's 2027 C-HR spec table or on the C-HR overview page.

cargo_cu_ft.note: 'Cargo volume behind rear seat (cu. ft.) (with JBL speakers)' 25.3; 'behind front seat' 59.5. Toyota labels both trims' figures 'with JBL speakers'.

battery.text: Electric Vehicle Drive Components Warranty (Transaxle, Traction Battery, Inverter with Converter): 96 months/100,000 miles

highway_tests.note: C/D 75-mph highway range test. Temperature not stated.

notes.text: EPA hasn't listed the 2027 C-HR yet. The range shown is Toyota's EPA estimate, which matches EPA's 2026 listing.
Peak DC rate is from Car and Driver's test sheet; Toyota's pages give only the charger power assumed for the 10-80% time.
